verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key (FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP smart card, PIV) with a device-management CLI. Setting up background automations that run on their own is not a capability this kind of product ships, so the story is a category error rather than a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey offers scheduling or autonomous jobs; the nitropy CLI is a tool for interacting with the device, not an automation platform.
